newsitem.title: USA: NAL sees Q4 diluted EPS between $0.14-$0.20.
newsitem.headline: NAL sees Q4 diluted EPS between $0.14-$0.20.

text.p: NAL Financial Group Inc said Friday it anticipates fourth quarter earnings will be below analysts estimates of $0.26 per diluted share, and will likely range from $0.14 to $0.20 per diluted share, resulting in earnings of $0.86 to $0.92 for 1996.
The company said the recent decline in its stock was likely due to speculation about its fourth quarter results.
The company said expenses were higher than planned in the fourth quarter due to a delay in eliminating redundancies between NAL and its recently acquired subsidiary, Special Finance Inc.
And the company said it is moving toward more conservative assumptions related to gain-on-sale and reserve practices.
